recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future GTIN URI, OID, or description corrections should be made in THO/NamingSystem-gtin rather than by restoring retired core registry rows or NamingSystem bundles.
issue_request: FHIR-13499 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-I STU3 change request to define a system URI for GTIN numbers; the final decision selected https://www.gs1.org/gtin after GS1 confirmation rather than the initially suggested gtin.info URL.
initial_application: The seed was applied by 72686673f4ac6015711e1e3bc64890e7459fe94a, which added NamingSystem/gtin to source/namingsystem/namingsystem-registry.xml with kind identifier, OID 1.3.160, and URI https://www.gs1.org/gtin. FHIR-17940 later added a same-family GTIN row to source/terminologies-systems.html using the same URI and OID.
additional_context: Later Published Vocabulary decisions FHIR-37853 and FHIR-37889 moved external terminology and identifier authority to HL7 Terminology (THO), removed non-authoritative external rows from terminologies-systems.html, and removed duplicate core NamingSystem bundles. Current identifier-registry.html and terminologies-systems.html are active build pages that direct readers to THO, and hl7.terminology 7.1.0 contains NamingSystem/gtin with preferred URI https://www.gs1.org/gtin and OID 1.3.160. The combined branch already contains a separate no-change audit for FHIR-17940.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Re-adding GTIN to core source would duplicate THO and reverse the later source-of-truth decisions; the current core page plus THO NamingSystem satisfy the seed request.

related_jiras.note: Later GTIN terminology-systems documentation used the same GS1 GTIN URI and was already audited on the combined branch.
Made THO authoritative for external code and identifier systems and removed the core GTIN row from terminologies-systems.html.
Removed core NamingSystem registry bundles, including the historical GTIN NamingSystem source, because they duplicated THO.
